description: Cash-ETF closing/opening auction fill-cost measurement (docs/PHASE2/EXEC_MEASUREMENT/PREREG.md). One row per round trip: buy 1 trading unit of 1343, 1591 or 1348 at the closing auction with 引成 (FrontOrderType 16) and sell it at the next opening auction with 寄成 (FrontOrderType 13), 50 round trips per symbol (1348 added by the owner decision in PREREG.md 追記 2026-09-06, pass bar 2.7 bps), to replace the ASSUMED 'one tick per side' rounding cost with a measured round-trip execution cost c. Written by src/bot/jpx/etf_auction_executor.py; the ledger row is finalised on a LATER day than the trade, once /orders exposes the fill Details.
source: kabuステーションAPI (localhost REST): fills from GET /orders?product=1&details=true -> Details[] rows with RecType 8 (約定); trading unit and 値幅制限 from GET /symbol; board snapshots from GET /board. Printed close/open and the linked index come from the daily vendor series the P2-02 / P2-03 judgments used (data/onr/etf_1343_daily.csv, data/onr/reit_index_daily.csv, and the 1591 / 1348 equivalents). 1348's ex-dividend exclusion dates are derived from the frozen dividend snapshot backtest_data/jpx_etf_daily_20260906_topix_alt/1348.T.json rather than re-fetched.
retention: PERMANENT. Unlike the ON1/ONR paper ledgers this is NOT re-derivable from inputs: a fill price is an exchange fact that exists nowhere else once /orders ages out. Never delete, never overwrite in place, never rebuild. Rows are appended only.

symbol.meaning: ETF code traded (1343 J-REIT, 1591 JPX400, 1348 TOPIX)

entry_date.meaning: session whose CLOSING auction the buy was sent for

exit_date.meaning: next session whose OPENING auction the sell was sent for

trading_unit.meaning: 売買単位 read from GET /symbol TradingUnit at entry
trading_unit.notes: 1343 = 10, 1591 = 1 as pre-registered; a mismatch stops the symbol (S6) and no order is sent

qty.meaning: quantity actually ordered; always exactly one trading unit

exchange.meaning: kabusapi Exchange sent on the order (9 = SOR, 27 = 東証+)

exchange_name.notes: the only evidence of where SOR actually routed the auction order -- an open 不明 in the spec

entry_order_id.meaning: OrderId returned by POST /sendorder for the buy

fill_buy.meaning: realised buy price, quantity-weighted over Details[] RecType 8

fill_buy_time.meaning: ExecutionDay / RecTime of the last buy execution row

print_close.notes: from the SAME daily vendor series the P2-02/P2-03 judgments used -- see known_defects

print_source.meaning: path of the daily series the two prints came from
print_source.notes: recorded per row so a change of series is visible

board_close_snapshot.meaning: GET /board CurrentPrice taken just before the entry order was built
board_close_snapshot.notes: secondary print reference, independent of the vendor series

board_open_snapshot.meaning: GET /board CurrentPrice taken just before the exit order was built
board_open_snapshot.notes: pre-open board; not an auction price

idx_close.meaning: linked index close on entry_date (東証REIT指数 for 1343, JPX日経400 for 1591, TOPIX for 1348)
idx_close.notes: DIAGNOSTIC ONLY -- never enters c or the pass/fail decision

tick_yen.meaning: 呼値 at print_close, from the JPX ETF tick table
tick_yen.notes: duplicated from config/constants.yaml jpx_cash_equity.etf_tick_size_yen_by_price_band; a test pins the two copies together

e_buy_bps.meaning: (fill_buy - print_close) / print_close in bps; positive = bought above the print

e_sell_bps.meaning: (print_open - fill_sell) / print_open in bps; positive = sold below the print

c_bps.meaning: round-trip execution cost: printed overnight return minus realised overnight return, plus commission in bps. THE quantity the measurement exists to produce
c_bps.notes: defined as the subtraction; e_buy + e_sell is only a first-order check and a disagreement above 0.5bps is flagged in note

commission_yen.meaning: sum of Details[] Commission over both legs
commission_yen.notes: expected 0 on SOR; a non-zero value is recorded as stop rule S7 (record, do not stop)

commission_tax_yen.meaning: sum of Details[] CommissionTax over both legs

pnl_yen.notes: recorded, but PREREG section 1 FORBIDS using realised pnl as evidence about the overnight premium: n=50 has no power there

cum_pnl_yen.meaning: running cumulative pnl_yen across both symbols in ledger order

counted_in_n.meaning: whether this round trip enters the n = 50 estimate

excluded_reason.meaning: why it does not, when counted_in_n is False
excluded_reason.notes: not_filled / partial_fill / print_series_missing -- excluded rows are KEPT as rows, never deleted, so a change in the exclusion rule stays detectable

symbol / job / event.meaning: which symbol, which job (entry/exit/reconcile/ledger), which outcome
symbol / job / event.notes: events: dry_run_order, order_accepted, order_state_unknown, order_not_sent, order_rejected, skip, alert, config_problem, stop_rule, row, pending

live.meaning: whether the triple LIVE gate was armed for this run
live.notes: false means the payload was written here and nothing was sent anywhere

payload.notes: carries no credential: the token is a header and the API password only ever appears in POST /token. Every line is written through logging_setup.redact

status.notes: STATE_UNKNOWN on EITHER symbol stops BOTH; it is cleared only by a human after a read-only reconcile

position.meaning: the single open long, when status is LONG

orders.meaning: per-day send counter, incremented BEFORE the send
orders.notes: cap 2 per symbol per day, so an ambiguous failure still consumes its slot

pending.meaning: round trips whose fills are not visible yet
pending.notes: drained into the ledger by the read-only finaliser

nofill_streak.meaning: consecutive nights without a full fill

rules (paused.json).notes: S1/S3/S4/S6. Never auto-resumes; a human calls clear(operator_confirm=True)

known_defects: print_close / print_open come from the daily vendor series used by the P2-02 and P2-03 judgments; there is NO guarantee they equal the exchange's official close/open. That is exactly why board_close_snapshot / board_open_snapshot are taken as an independent secondary reference -- if the two disagree, c is only as good as the print it is measured against

GET /orders is eventually consistent, so the fill Details of an order accepted at 15:20 or 08:40 may not be visible for some time. The ledger row is therefore finalised on a LATER run (the next entry job, or a human run of scripts/run_etf_measure_reconcile.py), not by the job that sent the order. A round trip whose orders are not yet visible stays in state_<symbol>.json pending and is NOT written as an unfilled row

where SOR (Exchange 9) routes a 引成 / 寄成 order, and whether that order joins the exchange auction at all, is not documented in kabu_STATION_API.yaml. exchange_name is recorded per row so the routing can be read off the ledger after the fact; until it is confirmed on the verification port 18081 the routing must be treated as unknown
cum_pnl_yen runs across BOTH symbols in ledger append order, which is the order fills became visible, not necessarily trade order. It is used only for the S4 stop line, never for inference
a dry-run round trip produces NO ledger row at all (there is no fill to measure). Dry-run activity is visible only in events.jsonl
